limitations: No verified individual facility coordinates were found; the DIC estate drawing and estate reference location were not assigned to named firms.
No actual measured air-emissions values were found in the reviewed records. Permit limits are recorded separately and are not treated as measured emissions.
The Sud Chemie historical consent lists natural gas and biomass under raw materials; fuel use is therefore unavailable rather than inferred.
The Indo German furnace-oil use and Rubber O Malabar boiler fuel are historical records and do not establish present fuel use.
The public rejected-application list reviewed covers 2014-2024. It does not establish consent history after that period; later grants, revocations or renewals may be unindexed or unavailable.
A consent document's stated expiry is reported as printed; subsequent revocation or variation was not independently verified.
Environmental-clearance searches did not identify facility records; the result is not evidence that no clearance exists.
The Edayar facility list is candidate-only; current operation is not established for every named unit.

Indo German historical fuel/process details were also checked in a public Studylib reproduction of the Local Area Environmental Committee audit (document id 8455809) because the CPCB-hosted PDF endpoint redirected; the source register marks this secondary access path.
Arjuna Natural?s 2024 sustainability report reports an Edayar energy-consumption reduction but does not provide pollutant-emission measurements or a facility fuel breakdown.

The 2025-2026 OCMMS approved/rejected queries attempted on 2026-10-25 returned 497-byte Data Unavailable HTML pages, not status records; current registry status after the last accessible records remains unverified.
ranking_policy: No facility is ranked or called a pollution source. Facility proximity, industrial category, consent history, fuel use, boiler registration or stack design alone are not causal evidence; time-aligned measured pollutant and meteorology evidence is absent.
